content.title: Vacation Cruises – Experience Norwegian Cruise Line
content.text: Countdown is 1 day, 51 minutes and 6 seconds Limited Time Offer Roam the Seas at Your Speed Out here, we steer the ship but leave the rest up to you. Discover what's new on Norwegian Aura™ Meet the all-new Norwegian Aura™, where different doesn’t even touch the surface. Redefining family vacations starting in 2027! Limited-time offer: New sailings added! Plan a future family cruise to the Caribbean, The Bahamas, Bermuda and more and bring the kids for free! Book now, before this offer ends – select sailings only. Military Perks! For a limited-time, receive up to $100 Onboard credit in addition to 10% off any cruise! Offer ends 4/27. Everywhere You Want to Go and Nowhere You Don't Select a destination and discover the ports of call that get you there. Get Familiar with Our Fleet Award-winning ships that bring a different experience to cruising around the world with endless dining, entertainment and experience options. Your Choice of Accommodations From solo studios to The Haven’ s luxurious suites hidden away in an exclusive enclave, we’ve got spaces to choose from that feels right for you and yours. Ships Driven to be Different Set sail on ships that take your leisure seriously with spaces for relaxation and limitless activities, all built around your schedule. Meet Our Newest Ship Norwegian Luna™ is the newest ship sailing the Caribbean. Feel the rush of the Aqua Slidecoaster, swim on top of the ocean in the infinity pools, and enjoy dinner with a moonlit stroll on Ocean Boulevard. Norwegian Luna sparkles, day or night. Prices are shown in USD unless otherwise noted.
